a.lede: OpenAI is rolling out new shopping features for ChatGPT that let users virtually try on clothing and accessories using their own photos and save products they like to a Favorites library.
a.title: ChatGPT can now virtually try on clothes for you

b.lede: OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.
b.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
